title: When the Glasshouse Breaks
author: Casper Lockridge
blurb: Emrys Ishikawa, a restaurant critic who has forgotten how food tastes, has spent seven years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then the last speaker of a language asks for one final student — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
